name: Neon noir
summary: A night crime film in colour. A lone driver or a replicant moves through a wet city of signs. Magenta and cyan light hits glass, rain and chrome. The pace is slow, the score is synthesised and the symmetry is cold.

philosophy.core_thesis: Coloured signs and a synth score turn the noir trap into a glowing night city, so the viewer reads loneliness in a clean, still, stylised frame.
design_principles: Light the night with neon in magenta and cyan, and let one sign be the key and a second sign the rim.
Compose in 2.39:1 with the figure small and central, in a symmetric street or a corridor.
Wet the ground so it mirrors the signs, and add haze to show the beam.
Move the camera on a slow dolly or a car mount at 0.2 to 0.6 m/s, or hold it still.
Hold a take for 6 to 15 s, with a pause before and after each line and a long close shot on the face.
Use a synthesiser score with a steady pulse, and keep the dialogue short.
Keep the hero silent and the violence short, sudden and clear.
anti_patterns: A talkative hero who explains the plot

composition.framing: A symmetric 2.39:1 frame: a lone figure in a lit corridor, a street or a car, with a sign in the top corner.
composition.staging_in_depth: 3 planes: a wet foreground, the figure and a far sign or tower in haze.
composition.subject_placement: The figure centred or on a third line, at 15% to 30% of the frame height.

principles.rule: Hold a night frame in a dark base, a neon key and a small second accent.
Pair a bright neon tube against a deep black street.
Centre the street or corridor and let the vanishing point sit on the axis.
Keep the figure small in a large lit space.
Hold each take and pause before the cut.

camera_and_movement.movement: A slow dolly, a car mount or a locked shot; a slow push toward a face; a drift along a glass wall.
camera_and_movement.support: Dolly, car mount, steadicam and tripod
camera_and_movement.camera_height: 1.2 to 1.7 m; 0.8 m in a car

lens_and_format.focal_length: 24mm to 50mm for the city; 85mm to 135mm for a face
lens_and_format.aperture: f/1.4 to f/2.8 with neon bokeh
lens_and_format.focus: Shallow focus with a clear face and a soft neon bokeh behind
equipment: a dolly or a car mount

light.quality: Coloured and hard from neon tubes, with a haze that shows the beam and a deep black.
light.direction: From the side or behind, with the sign in the frame as a key.
light.colour_temperature: Mixed: neon at 2700K to 10000K, or gels in magenta and cyan
light.source: Neon signs, LED panels and car lamps

colour_and_grade.treatment: A graded night with a magenta key and a cyan fill, deep teal blacks and clean, glossy highlights.
grade_recipe: Shift the shadows toward teal by 10% and the highlights toward magenta by 10%.
Raise the saturation of magenta and cyan by 20% to 30%.
Set the black point at 3% and keep the blacks deep.
Add a bloom of 10% to 15% on the neon.
colour_and_grade.texture: Glow around the neon, wet gloss and light grain

editing_and_rhythm.average_shot_length: 6 to 12 s (estimate; check Cinemetrics for each title)
editing_and_rhythm.shot_length_range: 1 s for a blow to 40 s for a drive
editing_and_rhythm.cutting_logic: Hold the shot and let the silence run; cut on a look; make the violence a single sudden cut.
editing_and_rhythm.transitions: Hard cut, a slow dissolve and a fade through black.

sound.approach: A clean mix with a deep synthesiser bed, city hum and sharp, close effects.
sound.dialogue: Sparse and low; the hero speaks less than 10% of the runtime.
sound.music: A synthesiser score with a pulse of 90 to 130 bpm, and one or two pop songs.

titles_and_graphics.treatment: A neon-lit title over a night city; a pink or a cyan script in a glow.
titles_and_graphics.type: A script or a bold sans-serif in magenta or cyan with a glow, 3 to 5 s per card.

shot_primer.opening: Open on a wide shot of a night street or a drive, hold it for 8 s with the synthesiser pulse, then show the face.

shot_list.shot: Night drive, signs on the glass
Face lit by a neon sign
Lone figure in a symmetric corridor

emotion.target_response: Cool melancholy and cold awe: the viewer is alone in a bright night city and feels its beauty and its threat.

use_cases: night city and car video prompts
avoid_when: The brief needs a warm, daylight or family tone.
The scene needs fast action with a lot of cuts.

modifiers.how: Remove the colour; shoot in black and white with one hard key and a voice-over.
Keep the night city; swap the neon glass for a CRT screen, a grain and a 1980s computer prop.

colour_temperature.note: Neon and gels set the range.

sources.title: Foster Hirsch, Detours and Lost Highways: A Map of Neo-Noir (Limelight Editions, 1999)
